name: NEXUS 탐지 알림 수신 v2 - 강제 dry-run 후보

parameters.jsCode: const sd=$getWorkflowStaticData('global');sd.tickets=sd.tickets||{};sd.history=sd.history||[];const all=[...Object.values(sd.tickets),...sd.history].sort((a,b)=>String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id))),open=all.filter(t=>t.status==='open'),by_type={};for(const t of open){const k=t.ticket_type||'보안 경보';by_type[k]=(by_type[k]||0)+1;}return [{json:{http:200,body:{generated_at:new Date().toISOString(),summary:{open:open.length,closed:all.length-open.length,by_type},tickets:all,whitelist:Object.entries(sd.whitelist||{}).map(([ip,v])=>({ip,source:'상황판',...v}))}}}];
